decisions.reason: The editorial review requested in the source concerns the paperback cover, not the suitability or consistency of chapter illustrations.
Reviewing the client-supplied cover does not change the manuscript editing objective or any approved manuscript wording.
The source message separately introduces KDP upload assistance, which is already represented in this candidate; the cover preference does not modify the assistance requirement.
The cover preference and separate KDP assistance request do not change the existing general publication-readiness guidance.
The decision about retaining and reviewing the cover does not alter aspect-ratio, cropping, or pixelation requirements for chapter images.
The source makes no decision about copyright-page publisher attribution or presentation.
Retaining the supplied cover does not change the inclusion, placement, timing, or full-page treatment of chapter images.
The cover review decision has no effect on Chapter 12 heading hierarchy, punctuation, or capitalization.
The source does not replace or otherwise change the authoritative client-edited manuscript revision.
The cover preference does not change the requirement to omit the literal newline artifact from the book title.
